reconstruction_notes.en: Original living inspired-by short-stalked basal cup and rounded body with five inset spiral ambulacra, following PRI Helicocystoidea basic description. Broad quiet skeletal fields and continuous stalk/cup connection, no machined screw thread or mechanical nut. Nominal0.10m-class height, palette, simplified shallow top depression and omitted microplates/soft anatomy are art choices; no exact species, fossil scan or feeding mechanics claim.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创活体inspired-by短柄基杯及圆体，五条内嵌螺旋沟依据PRI Helicocystoidea基本描述。保留宽阔平静骨骼区，柄杯连续，不作车削螺纹或机械螺母。约0.10米名义高度、配色、简化顶部浅凹及省略微板/软组织均为美术设定；不主张精确种、化石扫描或取食机制复原。
